capital
$52m aggregate · Announced Jul 15, 2026
Disclosed $52m aggregate funding across three early-stage rounds (pre-seed, seed and Series A), not one $52m round. Protocol Labs is named among investors; per-round amounts, exact dates and Protocol Labs' specific round participation are not disclosed. July 15 is the financing-disclosure announcement date. NeuroAI based on noninvasive EEG; excluded from annual USD capital totals and the cumulative capital line.

BCI
capital
strategic investment · Announced Feb 12, 2025
Announced a strategic investment from NEOM and a partnership led by NEOM Investment Fund (NIF) to advance BCI-based therapies. Financing amount and round stage are not disclosed. The agreement plans a Brain-Computer Interface Center of Excellence within NEOM; the announcement does not establish that the center is built or operational.
